headlines.title: Allegiant and Bank of America Extend Co-Branded Credit Card Partnership
headlines.summary: Allegiant Travel Company (NASDAQ: ALGT) and Bank of America today announced a long-term extension of their co-branded credit card partnership, building on their successful relationship and shared commitment to customers well into the next decade. The renewed agreement reinforces both companies' commitment to delivering meaningful rewards, exclusive travel benefits and exceptional value to Allegiant customers through the award winning Allways Rewards Visa® card.

headlines.title: Bank Of America (BAC) Led Debt Financing For A Major Wealth Platform Deal
headlines.summary: Bank of America (NYSE:BAC) acted as a lead arranger for private debt financing backing Vanguard Group's acquisition of Altruist. The financing supports Vanguard's purchase of digital wealth platform Altruist, a fintech provider serving financial advisers and investors. The deal underscores large banks' continued role in funding technology driven wealth management platforms that aim to modernize client service.

headlines.title: Caterpillar faces further valuation risks despite machinery strength, Bank of America warns
headlines.summary: Bank of America has maintained its 'buy' rating on Caterpillar Inc (NYSE:CAT, XETRA:CAT) despite warning that its valuation could fall further as uncertainty over data centre investment persists.

headlines.title: Walmart's AI and advertising businesses strengthen Bank of America's bullish case
headlines.summary: Bank of America has reiterated its 'buy' rating on Walmart Inc (NYSE:WMT, XETRA:WMT) and raised its price target to $139 from $126, citing scope for further market share gains and stronger earnings growth.

headlines.title: Qualcomm's AI data centre ambitions offer upside, but Bank of America remains cautious
headlines.summary: Qualcomm Inc (NASDAQ:QCOM, XETRA:QCI), is positioning itself as a full-stack supplier to AI data centres, with ambitions to capture up to $50 billion of a rapidly expanding market.

description: Bank of America Corporation, through its subsidiaries, provides various financial products and services for individual consumers, small and middle-market businesses, institutional investors, large corporations, and governments worldwide. It operates through four segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets. The Consumer Banking segment offers traditional and money market savings accounts, certificates of deposit and IRAs, checking accounts, and investment accounts and products; credit and debit cards; residential mortgages and home equity loans; and direct and indirect loans. The GWIM segment provides investment management, brokerage, banking, and trust and retirement products and services; wealth management solutions; and customized solutions, including specialty asset management services. The Global Banking segment offers lending products and services, including commercial loans, leases, commitment facilities, trade finance, and commercial real estate and asset-based lending; treasury solutions, and underwriting and advisory services. The Global Markets segment provides market-making, financing, securities clearing, settlement, and custody services; securities and derivative products; and risk management products using interest rate, equity, credit, currency and commodity derivatives, foreign exchange, fixed-income, and mortgage-related products. Bank of America Corporation was founded in 1784 and is based in Charlotte, North Carolina.
